ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters. Estimated white-to-black pixel ratio is approximately 0.05:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark grey pigmentation spanning the majority of the fluke surface, punctuated by approximately 15-20 discrete, high-contrast white circular pixel blobs ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in diameter, concentrated primarily on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated internal pixel angle of 42 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:3 relative to the central convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by high-frequency pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks) more pronounced on the outer lateral margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral symmetrical lobes exhibiting a convex leading edge trajectory and a moderately concave sweep on the trailing edge toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the ventral surface, with the highest density located in the upper-medial region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, vertically-oriented fine white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detectable in the lower quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring consistent with barnacle attachment sites across both lobes; presence of live, high-intensity white barnacle clusters on the far distal tip of the left lobe and smaller clusters on the right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Irregular jagged chunk missing or heavily serrated section on the far lateral trailing edge of the right lobe, creating a distinct profile compared to the left.
